name: Split
late_run_function: Multiplies every on-hit effect

name: Grow
early_run_function: Bigger and harder-hitting bullets but slower to charge
late_run_function: Answer to armor; carries single-bullet builds

name: Poison
early_run_function: Steady damage on anything you tag
late_run_function: Ticks on every Split bullet; feeds Exploit

name: Pierce
late_run_function: Each pierce re-triggers on-hit effects

name: Quickdraw
late_run_function: Feeds every-Nth triggers quickly

name: Exploit
late_run_function: Multiplies damage on debuffed enemies

name: Shrapnel
late_run_function: Every Split bullet explodes: swarm shredder

name: Chill
late_run_function: Keeps debuff active for Exploit

name: Bloodshot
late_run_function: Huge bullet count at high HP

name: Field Medic
early_run_function: Rarely procs on a slow pistol
late_run_function: Regular healing once bullet count is high
deliberate_weakness: NEEDS REWORK: heals you so it is a perk; make it a weapon effect or cut

name: Blast Ring
late_run_function: Constant area control

name: Shockwave
late_run_function: Near-permanent crowd control
deliberate_weakness: Rarely triggers at slow fire rate

name: Echo
late_run_function: Self-feeding bullet loop
deliberate_weakness: Hits generation cap; hard to balance

name: Zigzag
late_run_function: Helps only with multi-bullet spreads

name: Ricochet
late_run_function: Extra hits multiply on-hit effects
deliberate_weakness: Bounce paths are hard to predict

name: Volatile Core
late_run_function: Chain-kill explosions in swarms
deliberate_weakness: Explosion cap and a perf risk

name: Soul Snatcher
late_run_function: +0.1% damage per kill; huge by level 8
deliberate_weakness: Weak in boss fights; strong in swarms

name: Reaper
early_run_function: Locked until Soul Snatcher is owned
late_run_function: +0.1% max HP per kill and heals with it
deliberate_weakness: Chained so it may never be drawn; capped

name: Gravity Seed
late_run_function: Turns every explosion into a vacuum bomb

name: Shard Bloom
early_run_function: Shards pile up on one enemy
late_run_function: Fast shard stacking with Split detonates targets

name: Third Strike
late_run_function: Third hit disintegrates a target
deliberate_weakness: Needs focus fire; weak vs swarms

name: Bond Arc
early_run_function: Links two enemies with a beam
late_run_function: Shares poison and chill down the chain

name: Twin Gate
early_run_function: First two walls become a portal pair
late_run_function: Bullets and enemies hop across the arena

name: Still Field
late_run_function: Bullets leave it faster and harder
deliberate_weakness: Timing matters; zone also freezes your shots
